The proof follow easily from the Rellich-Kondrachov theorem (see \cite[Theorem 6.2]{Ada75}), which states that the embedding $H^s(\Omega_\X) \hookrightarrow C(\overline{\Omega_\X})$ is compact for $s > \frac{m}{2}$, and from \cite[Theorem 4 \& Theorem 5]{TiaHon95}.

issues.failure_explanation:
The approximants depend on $\x$ only through finitely many point values and are continuous with respect to the sup-norm, but the hypotheses give only $H^s$-continuity of $F$ plus $C$-compactness of $\dom F$ (and def:compact even defines 'compact in $V$' as sequential precompactness with limits in the ambient space), which does not imply $C$-continuity.
